rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORlore
Exhibition name: Folklore
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1967).
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1978 as 'Folklore'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, lighter reverse. [Orange, light yellow reverse.] Strong orange, flushing from the base, reverse sweetcorn-yellow fading milky white.. Strong fragrance. 44 to 50 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, upright. Glossy foliage.

Height: 8' (245cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Vigorous. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Fragrant Cloud (hybrid tea, Tantau 1963) ×
Unnamed Seedling
